title: Retrieval-Augmented Correction for Generalist Medical Image Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2611.23189v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated segmentation is routinely used as the first step in quantitative image-based clinical workflows, where predicted masks are subsequently reviewed and corrected by human operators. Automated correction of the residual structural errors is currently addressed one anatomy at a time, so the number of trained correctors scales with the number of segmentation targets. We present GRACE, a retrieval-augmented refiner that edits an input mask under context drawn from a shared knowledge base of verified prior cases. The refiner is trained once on a multi-organ corpus spanning compact organs, cavities, branching vessels, and tumour lesions. In the held-out dataset-transfer evaluation, three held-out datasets query a fixed knowledge base built from training data only. translated_title: 面向通用医学图像分割的检索增强校正
translated_abstract: 自动化分割通常被用作基于图像的定量临床工作流程的第一步，预测得到的掩膜随后会由人工操作员进行审核和校正。目前，针对残余结构误差的自动校正是逐个解剖结构单独处理的，因此所需训练的校正器数量会随分割目标数量的增加而成比例增长。我们提出了GRACE，一种检索增强的掩膜精炼器，它利用从共享知识库中检索到的已验证历史病例作为上下文，对输入掩膜进行编辑。该精炼器仅在一个涵盖紧密器官、空腔、分支血管和肿瘤病灶的多器官语料库上进行一次训练。在留出数据集的迁移评估中，三个留出数据集查询一个仅由训练数据构建的固定知识库。另一项留一解剖结构实验测试了无参数索引扩展：将未见过的实体器官的已验证病例加入知识库，而精炼器保持冻结状态。
tldr: GRACE是一种检索增强的医学图像分割校正器，通过从已验证历史病例的共享知识库中检索上下文，仅需一次训练即可校正多种解剖结构的分割误差，并能在不重新训练模型的情况下扩展到新的器官。
en_tdlr: GRACE is a retrieval-augmented refiner that corrects segmentation errors across multiple anatomies with a single training by retrieving context from a shared knowledge base of verified prior cases, enabling parameter-free extension to unseen organs.
